_comment: Rung-local extension context for the #45 StatementCredential shape.
Authored HERE, never merged into the shipped @bifold/vrc-contexts witnessed-exchange
context: that file is bundled into the Keyring app and hot-reloaded from source in dev,
and a byte-level change there alters what the wallet signs. Same discipline ref-06p used
NOTE: digestMultibase is deliberately ABSENT. The W3C credentials/v2 base context already
defines it (security#digestMultibase, typed security#multibase) and marks it @protected —
redefining it to any other IRI is a fatal JSON-LD error, which is how this rung found out.
